newsitem.title: POLAND: MOSTOSTAL G SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: MOSTOSTAL G SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE ISSUE.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish construction company Mostostal Gdansk SA on Saturday approved a planned issue of 1.4 million shares ex-rights, the company's president said.
Lech Walczak told Reuters the shareholders also approved management's proposal to put 1996's entire 2.2-million-zloty net profit into reserves.
The firm has said it seeks the issue in June to raise about 20 million zlotys for acquisitions and machinery purchases and that the issue price would be set through book building.
Currently Mostostal Gdansk has 2.6 million shares outstanding.
